meta.triageRationale: One cohesive provider change with a single obvious approach; core edit at ollama.ts:425 plus a small config knob touching the config catalog/reconcile. No new subsystem, no cross-cutting contract, no DB/graph schema change.

findings.premise: OllamaProvider.embed() calls this.client.embed({ model, input }) WITHOUT a keep_alive argument (the bug this Story fixes).
findings.evidence: CONFIRMED verbatim: src/agent/providers/ollama.ts:425 reads `const result = await this.client.embed({ model: this.embeddingModel, input: text });` — no keep_alive argument, exactly the bug the Story fixes.

findings.premise: The shaper path complete()/chat() pins keep_alive:'24h' (the pattern embed() will mirror).
findings.evidence: Supported: the shaper path complete()/chat() pins keep_alive:'24h' (ollama.ts:342 conditional keepAlive + ln 501 literal '24h'), verified by direct inspection this session — the pattern embed() mirrors.

findings.premise: The config catalog registers a models.local.* block (host/embeddingModel/embeddingDim/coreModel/charsPerToken) where an additive models.local.embeddingKeepAlive field is registered.
findings.evidence: Supported: config-catalog.ts registers the models.local.* block (models.local.host/embeddingModel/embeddingDim/coreModel/charsPerToken at ln 111-116), the additive registration site for models.local.embeddingKeepAlive.

findings.premise: loadLocalProviderConfig (src/config/local.ts) is the local-provider config surface OllamaProvider reads via localDefaults(); it is where embeddingKeepAlive is surfaced.
findings.evidence: Supported: OllamaProvider memoizes localDefaults()=loadLocalProviderConfig() (ollama.ts:54-58); loadLocalProviderConfig lives in src/config/local.ts and is the models.local.* surface where embeddingKeepAlive is added.

findings.premise: The OllamaProvider constructor reads local defaults into private fields (e.g. this.embeddingModel = d.embeddingModel), the same pattern embeddingKeepAlive will follow.
findings.evidence: Supported: the constructor reads local defaults into private fields — `this.embeddingModel = d.embeddingModel` (ollama.ts:179) — the exact pattern embeddingKeepAlive follows.

findings.premise: The embed() delegators cli-provider and mcp-sampling-provider implement embed by delegating to embedDelegate.embed(text), so a keep_alive change inside OllamaProvider.embed() flows through them unchanged.
findings.evidence: Supported: cli-provider.ts:285-289 and mcp-sampling-provider.ts:258-266 implement embed() by delegating to embedDelegate.embed(text) (the LLMProvider.embed contract at shared/types.ts:181); the keep_alive change inside OllamaProvider.embed() flows through them unchanged.

findings.premise: Ollama's embeddings API accepts a keep_alive parameter governing model residency (string like '24h'/'-1'/'0'), so passing it in embed() keeps the embed model loaded without affecting the returned vector.
findings.evidence: External contract (Ollama): the embeddings API accepts keep_alive governing model residency (the shaper already uses '24h' successfully). keep_alive affects only residency, not the returned vector — an unrecognized value at worst reverts to default eviction (handled as a recoverable error case). Reasonable and low-risk.
findings.action: None — documented + guarded in error paths.

findings.premise: Adding a config-catalog field is carried forward by the schema-driven reconcile (fill/repair on boot/update) with no separate migration — an old config.json without the key keeps working.
findings.evidence: Supported: the config catalog + reconcile (config-catalog.ts CONFIG_CATALOG + reconcile.ts fill/repair) carry an additive field forward on boot/update — the established config-reconcile pattern; an old config.json without the key backfills to the catalog default.

hldContextSlice.frameworkSummary: Standalone feature — no parent HLD. Design directly against the repo, grounded on the s1 analyze passes. There are no HLD shared contracts to honour.

boundary.internal: Pin the Ollama embedding model keep-alive

api.name: embed

returns.meaning: The embedding vector (unchanged). INTERNAL CHANGE ONLY: the underlying `this.client.embed({ model, input })` call (ollama.ts:425) now also passes `keep_alive: this.embeddingKeepAlive`, so Ollama keeps the embed model resident instead of applying its ~5-min default. No signature/return change; delegators (cli-provider, mcp-sampling-provider) are unaffected.

preconditions: this.embeddingKeepAlive is set from config in the constructor (default '24h').
postconditions: The Ollama embeddings request carries a keep_alive; a '0' value opts back into eager unload; the returned vector is identical to before for the same input+model.

errorCases.scenario: config.json has an empty/blank models.local.embeddingKeepAlive (e.g. a hand-edit set it to "").
errorCases.detection: The OllamaProvider constructor reads d.embeddingKeepAlive and finds an empty string (loadLocalProviderConfig returned '' rather than the catalog default).
errorCases.response: Guard in the constructor: coalesce an empty/whitespace value to the '24h' default before storing, so embed() never passes keep_alive:'' (which Ollama would treat as an unspecified/odd value).
errorCases.userImpact: None — the embedder still gets a sane keep_alive; the operator's blank is treated as 'use default'.

errorCases.scenario: An operator sets models.local.embeddingKeepAlive to a string Ollama does not recognize (e.g. 'foo').
errorCases.detection: Ollama's embeddings endpoint receives the unrecognized keep_alive; it either errors on the request or ignores it — surfaced by the existing embed() error handling / the returned embeddings.
errorCases.response: Do not add bespoke validation: keep_alive only governs model residency, not embedding correctness. An unrecognized value at worst reverts to Ollama's default eviction behaviour (the pre-fix status quo); the value is documented in the field desc (24h / -1 / 0). Existing embed() error handling is unchanged.
errorCases.userImpact: At worst the embedder reverts to being evicted early (the old slow behaviour) — never wrong embeddings, never a crash.

edgeCases.expected: Ollama keeps the embed model resident indefinitely (forever) — best for big-memory hosts.
Eager unload after each request (explicit opt-out) — restores the pre-fix behaviour for a memory-tight host that prefers it; embeddings still correct, just cold.

edgeCases.input: An existing config.json written before this field existed (key absent).
edgeCases.expected: The schema-driven reconcile backfills models.local.embeddingKeepAlive='24h' on daemon boot/update; embed() gets the default with no operator action.

edgeCases.input: The embedder runs through cli-provider / mcp-sampling-provider (delegated embed).
edgeCases.expected: keep_alive is applied inside OllamaProvider.embed() regardless of the caller; the delegators pass through unchanged and are unaffected.

invariantsToPreserve.text: embed() returns the identical embedding vector for the same (input, embeddingModel) as before — keep_alive governs only Ollama model residency, never the embedding output or the method signature/return type.
The shaper's complete()/chat() keep_alive:'24h' behaviour is untouched — this Story adds a keep_alive to the embed path only, and does not alter the reasoning-model residency policy.

Adding models.local.embeddingKeepAlive is additive and carried forward by the existing schema-driven reconcile (fill on boot/update) — an old config.json without the key keeps working; no migration step, no RETIRED_PATHS/alias change.

migration.stateBefore: OllamaProvider.embed() (ollama.ts:423-425) issues `this.client.embed({ model, input })` with NO keep_alive, so Ollama applies its ~5-min default and evicts the embed model under memory pressure (cold ~2s reload vs ~0.1s warm). There is no models.local.embeddingKeepAlive config field; config.json files in the wild have no such key.
migration.stateAfter: config-catalog registers models.local.embeddingKeepAlive (string, default '24h'); loadLocalProviderConfig surfaces it; OllamaProvider.embed() passes `keep_alive` from it, keeping the embed model resident. Existing config.json files without the key are backfilled to '24h' by the schema-driven reconcile on the next daemon boot/update. Operators can override ('-1' forever, '0' eager-unload).

migrationSteps.action: Add the additive config-catalog entry { path:'models.local.embeddingKeepAlive', type:'string', default:'24h', desc:... } (a nullable/defaulted field — no value required from operators).
Surface embeddingKeepAlive on loadLocalProviderConfig's returned object (read models.local.embeddingKeepAlive, fall back to the catalog default).
In OllamaProvider: read d.embeddingKeepAlive in the constructor (coalescing empty/blank to '24h') and pass it as keep_alive in embed()'s client.embed call.

On the next daemon boot/update, the existing reconcile fill-step backfills models.local.embeddingKeepAlive='24h' into any config.json lacking it (no separate data rewrite; reuses the standard carry-forward).

migration.backwardCompat: No public API changes: embed()/loadLocalProviderConfig signatures and return types are unchanged (loadLocalProviderConfig gains a field, an additive superset). embed() delegators (cli-provider, mcp-sampling-provider) pass through untouched. An old config.json without the key works (reconcile backfills the default); setting the field to '0' exactly restores the pre-fix eviction behaviour. Rolling back the code leaves an orphan config key that is simply ignored.

alternativesConsidered.name: models.local.embeddingKeepAlive config knob
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Add a `models.local.embeddingKeepAlive` string field to the config catalog (default '24h'), expose it on the local-provider defaults, and pass it as keep_alive in embed().
pros: Tunable per host without a code change — memory-constrained boxes can lower it, big boxes can pin forever, matching the repo's config-first ethos.
Mirrors the existing models.local.* pattern (embeddingModel/host) exactly — no new plumbing shape; reconcile carry-forward is automatic.
A sensible default ('24h') fixes the flush out-of-the-box while staying overridable.
cons: Touches two files (catalog + local.ts) plus the provider, and adds a config-catalog test for the carry-forward — slightly more than a one-liner.

alternativesConsidered.name: Hardcoded keep_alive constant in embed()
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Pass a hardcoded `keep_alive: '24h'` (a named module constant) in embed(), no config surface.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Smallest change and fixes the default case, but bakes a policy that this session proved can be wrong on small-memory machines. Loses to a1 on host-tunable (violates vs satisfies).
pros: Smallest possible change — one file, one line + a constant; trivially testable.
Consistent with how the shaper already hardcodes its 24h keep_alive today.
cons: Not tunable — a memory-constrained host (exactly the failure mode that motivated this) can't dial it down without editing code + redeploying the daemon.
Bakes a policy decision ('24h') that this very session showed can be wrong on small-memory machines.

alternativesConsidered.name: Shared keep_alive constant for shaper + embedder
alternativesConsidered.oneLineSummary: Extract ONE shared keep_alive constant/config used by BOTH complete()/chat() and embed(), unifying the policy.
alternativesConsidered.reasonRejected: Conceptually DRY but conflates two very different residency footprints and disturbs the working shaper path. Loses to a1 on minimal-blast-radius (violates vs partial) and host-tunable (partial vs satisfies).
pros: DRY — one keep_alive policy instead of an asymmetric shaper-24h / embed-default split.
Eliminates the asymmetry that caused the bug at its root.
cons: Broader blast radius: edits the shaper's complete()/chat() call sites (currently working) to fix an embed-only problem — more risk than the acceptance requires.

Conflates two different residency needs: the 23GB shaper and the 0.6GB embedder have very different memory footprints and ideally want different keep_alive values on a tight box — a single knob can't express that.
